title: Benchmark registry (Content-Grounding §6.3)
description: Governed 'what good looks like' references — the third comparison axis. Each entry references an existing KPI and cites a dated public source via a source_type from benchmark_sources.yaml.

kpi_id.description: Must resolve to a governed KPI under core/kpi_catalog/kpis/ (Golden Thread).

scope.description: Population the benchmark describes (sector, geography, segment).

metric.description: Which point of the reference distribution this value is.

value.description: Benchmark value in the KPI's unit.

unit.description: Unit class of value (must be consistent with the KPI's unit_format).

direction.description: Which side of the benchmark is good.

source.description: Concrete citation: author/publisher, year, what the figure is. No bare assertions.

source_type.description: Must be a key in benchmark_sources.yaml source_types.

as_of.description: ISO date the benchmark was recorded/verified.
